Pentakill is a virtual heavy metal band associated with the League of Legends universe. consisting of five themed versions of League of Legends characters Yorick, Karthus, Mordekaiser, Sona, and Olaf with Kayle and Veigo as a guest appearance. With their debut album Smite and Ignite in 2014. Their music is primarily composed and performed by Riot Games' in-house music team but features cameos by various metal musicians. For example, Jørn Lande as a lead vocalist or Joe Atlan as the keyboardist. Their second album, Grasp of the Undying, reached Number 1 on the iTunes metal charts in 2017. Their third album, III: Lost Chapter, premiered using an interactive "live" concert.
Pentakill was developed by Riot Games, the company behind League of Legends. The band started as cosmetic skins for League of Legends game characters during the 2010s. Because people joked about wanting to hear the band music. Riot games decide to bring the band to life with full length album. on June 3, 2014 Riot Games release their debut, Smite and Ignite album on Youtube.
